name: Molefi Makuebu
desc:
Molefi Makuebu is a PhD candidate in the Intelligent Connectivity Group at the University of Cape Town (UCT), South Africa. His research focuses on intelligent traffic classification, machine learning, and intent-aware resource allocation for 5G and beyond networks.
Research Interests: Network slicing, machine learning, deep learning, encrypted traffic classification, intent-aware network management, resource optimisation, and AI-native 5G/6G networks.
